component.name: ShareV
component.summary: Capture, annotate, share and record your screen

description.p: ShareV is a ShareX-style screen capture and sharing tool for Linux. It captures regions, windows or the full screen and lets you annotate, upload and share the result — and record your screen to video or animated GIF.

ul.li: Region, window and fullscreen capture with a delay.
Annotation editor with arrows, shapes, text, blur and crop.
Share to Imgur, a custom HTTP endpoint or a shell command.
Record MP4, WebM or animated GIF with system and microphone audio.
Capture history and a system tray menu.
